import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


def _block(x, conv1_weight, norm1_weight, norm1_bias,
           conv2_weight, norm2_weight, norm2_bias, eps):
    xl = x.contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    w1 = conv1_weight.contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    w2 = conv2_weight.contiguous(memory_format=torch.channels_last)
    out = F.conv2d(xl, w1, None, 1, 1)
    out = F.group_norm(out, 32, norm1_weight, norm1_bias, eps)
    out = F.silu(out)
    out = F.conv2d(out, w2, None, 1, 1)
    out = F.group_norm(out, 32, norm2_weight, norm2_bias, eps)
    out = F.silu(out)
    return out + xl


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    """torch.compile reduce-overhead (CUDA graphs) — targets launch overhead at small shapes."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._fn = torch.compile(_block, mode="reduce-overhead", dynamic=False)

    def forward(self, *inputs):
        return self._fn(*inputs)

import torch as _sb_torch  # noqa: E402

_SB_MODEL = None
_SB_INIT_ARGS = []


def run(*args):

    if _SB_MODEL is None:
        _m = ModelNew(*_SB_INIT_ARGS)
        if isinstance(_m, _sb_torch.nn.Module):
            if _sb_torch.cuda.is_available():
                _m = _m.cuda()
            _m.eval()
        _SB_MODEL = _m
    with _sb_torch.no_grad():
        return _SB_MODEL(*args)
